title: Correct Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must identify the correct boundary condition in magnetostatics as (a).

title: Understanding of Boundary Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the significance of the boundary condition related to the magnetic field B.

title: Clarity of Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student should provide a clear rationale for why (a) is the correct choice over (b) and (c).

title: Use of Terminology
description: Optional Criteria: The student may correctly use terms like magnetic field B and magnetic field strength H in their explanation.

title: Common Misconceptions
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid stating that the component of H normal to the surface has the same value, which is incorrect.
